items.topic: Ailey/Fordham BFA deadline: November 1 or November 8?
items.finding: November 1, 2026. Fordham's current admission page lists Early Action and Early Decision I at Nov. 1, 2026, and the Ailey page also says November 1, 2026 for both applications; the November 8 date looks like an old extension from an earlier cycle. Fordham also wants the FAFSA and CSS Profile by November 15, 2026 for Early Action.

items.topic: Dance Masters of America scholarships and 2027 nationals
items.finding: The 2027 National Convention is at Kalahari Resort in Sandusky, Ohio: intensives July 2 to 4, Solo Title July 3 to 10, Convention and Performing Arts Competition July 5 to 10, 2027. Its Open Scholarship auditions (ages 13 to 23) are only for students of a DMA member teacher, and the national site shows no college scholarship program.

items.topic: Hollywood Connection 2026-27 Florida stops and scholarships
items.finding: The 2027 tour has no Florida city; the closest is Atlanta, February 5 to 7, 2027, and National Finals run June 25 to July 2, 2027. Scholarships are free-tuition awards handed out at events, plus a need-based Backstage Foundation convention scholarship due December 20, 2026.

items.topic: Showbiz Talent 2027 Florida stops and scholarships
items.finding: Florida regionals are Lakeland Feb 5 to 7, Boca Raton Feb 12 to 14, Daytona Beach Apr 23 to 25 and Miami May 7 to 9, 2027, with National Finals at the Ocean Center in Daytona Beach June 23 to 28, 2027. The site doesn't mention any scholarship program, so treat it as a competition, not a money source.

The old official site, thepulseontour.com, now shows unrelated blog posts and no tour dates, and no 2026-27 tour or scholarship program turned up anywhere. Treat it as not running unless a teacher hears otherwise.

items.topic: Princess Cruises casting and age rule
items.finding: Princess casts on its own site and says you must be 18 to audition or be hired; contracts are a 6 to 8 week rehearsal plus at least 6 months onboard, and you can apply online without a live audition. Jazz, ballet, partnering and musical theatre are required, and tap is a bonus, so this opens up for you after October 13, 2027.

items.topic: Celebrity Cruises casting and age rule
items.finding: There's no Celebrity-only casting page anymore; Celebrity is a Royal Caribbean Group brand, and the group's ship careers site lists performers under Entertainment and Recreation. No age rule is printed there, and older Celebrity casting notices said 18 and up, so plan on 18.

items.topic: Does the Radio City Christmas Spectacular hire men?
items.finding: The Rockettes line itself is women, but the show also casts Ensemble Dancers (jazz and ballet, plus learning a song at the audition), and past Radio City casting notices held separate male ensemble calls. The official page doesn't say gender; ensemble dancers must be 18 by the first October rehearsal, 2026 registration is closed, and you can sign up for 2027 alerts.

items.topic: Hubbard Street free video audition week: which year?
items.finding: The page says October 19 to 25 with no year, but it sits above the 2027 audition calendar, and October 19, 2026 is a Monday, so it almost certainly means next week (October 19 to 25, 2026). Email Hubbard Street now to confirm, because a free video audition beats paying the fee in February.

No official national scholarship for male high school seniors turned up; the male-only programs found are ballet-school or younger-kid programs. The closest real edge is the Elks Most Valuable Student award, which judges boys and girls separately.

Real, but it's Pittsburgh CLO's awards for its participating Pittsburgh-area high school musicals, so you can't enter from Florida. The Central Florida version is the Dr. Phillips Center Applause Awards, already on the auditions list.

items.topic: Entertainment Community Fund (formerly The Actors Fund)
items.finding: Its dancer money (Career Transition for Dancers) goes to working professionals and dancers in graduate programs, not high school seniors. Bookmark it for later in your career, not for this year.

The homepage shows no scholarships for individual high school students; its money goes to arts groups plus an Individual Artist Award. It's worth one email to info@unitedartscfl.org to ask about student opportunities.
No active Florida Dance Association site or student scholarship could be found. The live statewide dance group is FDEO, already on the list.

items.topic: Dizzy Feet Foundation (now American Dance Movement)
items.finding: Reports say awards up to $10,000 go only to students nominated by invited dance schools, and individuals can't apply directly. The official site wouldn't load (security certificate error), so nothing here is confirmed.

This is a college savings plan families buy into, not a scholarship you apply for as a senior, so it wasn't researched further. Ask your family whether one already exists, because it changes the money math for Florida schools.
Skip it: the 2027 cycle is only for seniors graduating from Texas high schools and going to Texas public universities.
